list_capabilities.name: harbor.member.open_sub_account
list_capabilities.title: Open a sub-account for a member
list_capabilities.description: Sign on to the teller console, look up member {{member_id}}, open a new {{product}} sub-account funded with an initial deposit of {{initial_deposit}} from the member's Share Savings (suffix S01), confirm it, and read the confirmation number.

initial_deposit.description: Initial deposit transferred from Share Savings, e.g. 25.00 (decimal, e.g. 25.00)

confirmation_number.description: Confirmation number of the opened sub-account

business_outcomes.deposit_below_minimum: The initial deposit is below the product minimum ($5.00).
business_outcomes.member_not_found: Search returned no member for the given number.
business_outcomes.invalid_member_number: The application rejected the member number format.
business_outcomes.member_fraud_alert: Member has an active fraud alert; information must not be disclosed without ID verification.

list_capabilities.name: harbor.member.savings_balance
list_capabilities.title: Member savings balance lookup
list_capabilities.description: Sign on to the teller console, look up member {{member_id}}, and read the current balance of their Share Savings account and the member's name.

savings_balance.description: Current balance of the member's Share Savings account, as a decimal string

member_name.description: Member's name as shown on the member record

business_outcomes.member_not_found: Search returned no member for the given number.
business_outcomes.invalid_member_number: The application rejected the member number format.
business_outcomes.member_fraud_alert: Member has an active fraud alert; information must not be disclosed without ID verification.
